simple.summary: מְסֻכָּה (mᵉçukkâh) means a covering , i.e. garniture First listed occurrence: Ezek 28 13.

definitions.full: H4540. mesukkah [ מְסֻכָֿה ] noun feminine that with which one is covered, covering ; — suffix מְסֻכָֿתָ֑ךָ Ezek 28:13 (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ׳מְסֻכּ ) all precious stones were thy covering (= thou wast covered with them); — the tradition is strong in favour of Raph¢ , but sense favours derivation from סכך .
